# HealOra

HealOra is a software and AI studio based in Bolton, Greater Manchester, UK. We design and build websites, business applications and AI systems — scoped in writing, built by senior engineers, and handed over with documentation.

## Contact
- Website: https://www.healora.org/
- Email: healora98@gmail.com
- Phone: +44 7445 750757
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/healoratech/
- Location: Bolton, Greater Manchester, United Kingdom

## Selected work
- [Blackstone UK Recruitment](https://www.healora.org/work/) — UK recruitment platform. HealOra ran the full pre-launch QA audit across candidate, employer and admin workflows and produced the launch films. Live at https://bsukrecruitment.com
- [Pluggz](https://www.healora.org/work/) — UK creator shopping platform. HealOra cleared the full QA backlog, hardened admin tooling and shipped the platform to production. Live at https://pluggzofficial.co.uk

## Services
1. [Deep Tech, AI & R&D](https://www.healora.org/services/deep-tech-r-and-d/) — Feasibility studies and proof-of-concepts for hard technical questions
2. [Websites & Apps](https://www.healora.org/services/websites-and-apps/) — Business websites and custom applications people actually enjoy using
3. [AI Agents & Bots](https://www.healora.org/services/ai-agents-and-bots/) — AI assistants wired into real workflows, with human oversight
4. [Blockchain & Web3](https://www.healora.org/services/blockchain-and-web3/) — Shared-record systems, only where trust genuinely needs code
5. [Quantum Computing](https://www.healora.org/services/quantum-computing/) — Simulations and algorithm exploration, assumptions stated up front
6. [VR / AR Solutions](https://www.healora.org/services/vr-ar-solutions/) — Immersive training and demos, scoped to actual devices
7. [Cybersecurity](https://www.healora.org/services/cybersecurity/) — Authorised security assessments with a prioritised fix list
8. [Bioinformatics & Genomics](https://www.healora.org/services/bioinformatics-genomics/) — Reproducible data pipelines for biological research
9. [AI-Driven Drug Discovery](https://www.healora.org/services/ai-drug-discovery/) — Computational support for early-stage research questions
